answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded attestation reef: each new identity must lock a copper-denominated stake sized to the max reward one vote can capture, held until an epoch settles. Peers only attest keys that share no funding graph with known clusters; if any twin cheats, the whole cluster's bonds are burned. That stake becomes the anchor of cost—an attacker buying n clones pays n full bonds plus total forfeiture, so manufactured influence costs more than the payoff.
